comparison.objective: Dry-fit and glue a broken mug handle, then align, press, and release the joint.
comparison.physical_skill: Precision mating of two fracture faces, controlled adhesive dispensing, and force application rather than screening and granular-flow management.
comparison.success_condition: Requires dry fit, 10–30 uL beads on both faces, tight pose tolerances, >=3 N pressing, clean placement, and released stability; candidate uses recovery mass and retained-washer outcomes.
comparison.reason: The record tests adhesive repair and precision seating, a different ability from selective separation. No material rubric detail is missing.
